items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The change is one line with a clear comment, '# Ensure base table is in the query', and it matches the reference. The added test has a descriptive name and follows the existing style in tests/delete/tests.py.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Reuses the existing helper query.get_initial_alias() inside single_alias. Collector and QuerySet.delete are untouched, and no logic is duplicated or left dead.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Small change with no new error paths. get_initial_alias() is idempotent and is already used the same way elsewhere in compiler.py (e.g. line 1537). The agent checked that joined deletes still use the subquery.

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: Fixes the root cause in single_alias by registering the base alias before counting. The agent confirmed that filter(user_permissions__name=...) still uses the subquery. The MySQL override benefits via single_alias, and there is no backend-specific branch. Hidden tests: F2P 1/1, P2P 52/52.
